claim: Adding a 'weddings' vector steers the topic
published: > 90% of completions about weddings vs ~2% unsteered (Turner et al.)
ours: wedding words in 0% of completions unsteered → 75% at c = 4 (random vector 0%); best 92%
criterion: c = 4 rate ≥ 50% and ≥ 30 points above both the unsteered and random-vector rates
